title: Learning a new skill as an adult
prompt: Talk about a time when you learned a new skill as an adult. What was the skill, how did you learn it, and how has it helped you?
structure: Name the skill in one sentence
Why you needed it (a specific moment)
How you learned it (method, time, who helped)
Result + how it helps you now / what you learned
modelAnswer:
The skill I'd like to talk about is using advanced Excel, especially pivot tables and lookup formulas.

A couple of years ago, I started a new job at a logistics company, and in my first week my supervisor asked me to prepare a monthly report on late deliveries. Honestly, I was a bit embarrassed, because I only knew the basics, and it took me almost a whole day.

So I decided to learn it properly. I signed up for a free online course through the public library, and every evening I spent about thirty minutes practising with real data from work. Whenever I got stuck, I watched short videos or asked a colleague who was good with spreadsheets.

After about two months, I could build the same report in less than an hour. Now my manager actually asks me to train new staff. Looking back, learning that skill gave me a lot more confidence at work, and it showed me that it's never too late to learn something new.

usefulExpressions.expression: The skill I'd like to talk about is…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Câu mở đầu rõ ràng, trả lời ngay câu hỏi 'What was the skill?'.

usefulExpressions.expression: Honestly, I was a bit embarrassed, because…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Chia sẻ cảm xúc thật làm câu chuyện sinh động và tự nhiên hơn.
'get stuck' = bị bí; 'whenever' diễn tả hành động lặp lại.
Nhìn lại — dùng để rút ra bài học ở cuối câu chuyện.
Câu kết mang tính bài học, phù hợp với đề về học kỹ năng mới.

commonMistakes: Chỉ trả lời 1–2 trong 3 câu hỏi của đề. Hãy đảm bảo nói đủ: kỹ năng gì, học thế nào, giúp ích ra sao.
Nói 'I learned to Excel' hoặc 'I learned about use Excel' — đúng là 'I learned how to use Excel'.
Thiếu từ nối giữa các phần, khiến bài nghe như liệt kê. Dùng 'So…', 'After about two months…', 'Now…', 'Looking back…'.

review.notes: Independent review: Checked skill/how/benefit all answered, natural spoken tone, length (~169). No changes needed.
